S1.name: A compiled policy persists across replicas with the intentional V1 default

S2.name: Revoking the policy entitlement refuses known policies on both replicas

S3.name: A sibling account cannot read or change a known policy ID

S4.name: Conditional updates and deletion refuse stale policy versions across replicas

S5.name: Merge patch keeps source and dialect while resetting nullable settings

S6.name: Both list and search cursors resume on another replica without skipped policies

S7.name: Invalid policy search requests and unknown spaces have public failures

S8.name: Account and inherited space searches use persistent policy projections

S9.name: Account-qualified attachments, candidates and preview never cross accounts

S10.name: Revoking the policy entitlement refuses every attachment operation

S11.name: Missing, malformed and mismatched attachment parents are refused

S12.name: Preview counts all matching targets and returns current target labels

S13.name: Explicit attachment persists once with distinct policy and attachment IDs

S14.name: Both replicas compile the default V1 and explicit V0 policy dialects

S15.name: Switching off expressions refuses policy checking

S16.name: Missing credentials and unknown dialects refuse checks

S17.name: Both replicas publish a complete schema through the ordinary account controls

S18.name: The installation's policies switch refuses contract reads

S19.name: Missing credentials and the database-backed caller switch refuse schema reads

S20.name: Both replicas report the OPA version actually linked from this build

S21.name: Switching off policies refuses runtime metadata reads

S22.name: Missing credentials and a disabled caller refuse runtime metadata

S23.name: An authorized queued review evaluates the real policy and releases the run

S24.name: A stack reader cannot supply a review

S25.name: Unknown runs and runs outside review states refuse a review

S26.name: A template is checked, completed and evaluated against a stack's environment, its secret masked

S27.name: With expressions switched off for the installation, each operation answers 403

S28.name: A misspelt variable is flagged with its range, and a source, cursor or surface the endpoints cannot use is refused

S29.name: Two servers expose historical evidence without leaking raw decisions or deleted policy source

S30.name: The run's own in-run API token reads its stack while the run plans, but neither the run nor its logs

S31.name: A run's priority is read back, its stack answers, and a stack's lists page newest first

S32.name: An unknown run, a cancel of a run that ended, a run named on another stack and a malformed search are refused

S33.name: The runs and tasks of a stack the caller cannot read answer as a stack that does not exist

S34.name: A stack with no runs lists empty pages of runs and tasks, and finds no run by ID

S35.name: An altered cursor on a stack's runs or tasks answers 400

S36.name: C9 forced deletion removes the policy and both attachment projections

S37.name: Compilation refusals preserve the stored body and engine

P1.name: Once the run plans, both reads answer the plan's changes, and the run and its stack its delta

P2.name: A burst of runs on one stack is scheduled by one evaluation, and the stack's state follows its tracked run

P3.name: A space reader is refused, and a stack the caller cannot read does not exist

P4.name: An unknown commit, a disabled stack, a stack with no commit and an unknown field are refused

P5.name: A proposal on an uploaded workspace previews it on the tracked commit, and its worker fetches the archive

P6.name: A space reader is refused both calls, and a stack that does not allow local previews refuses everyone

P7.name: A declaration outside the bounds, an upload that is not the stack's, was never put or does not exist, and an override of a variable infraweave sets are refused

P8.name: A proposal's overrides reach its run's specification, sealed where the stack's variable is, and each proposal creates a run

P9.name: A space reader is refused, and a stack the caller cannot read does not exist

P10.name: An override of a variable infraweave sets, with no name, with = or given twice, an unknown commit and a value left out are refused

P11.name: A task runs on the tracked commit, carries its command to its specification, and each task is a run of its own

P12.name: A space reader is refused, a stack the caller cannot read does not exist, and a tier without tasks refuses them

P13.name: A blank command, an empty one, one holding a NUL byte, a body without a command and a disabled stack are refused

P14.name: Retrying an ended run queues a run of its type on its commit, which names the run retried

P15.name: A tracked run's retry needs RUN_RETRY_BLOCKING, which a space reader lacks

P16.name: A run that has not ended, and one that does not exist, are not retried

P17.name: Promoting a proposed run on a newer commit tracks the commit and queues a tracked run on it

P18.name: Promoting needs RUN_PROMOTE, which a space reader lacks

P19.name: A stack that does not allow promotion, and a tracked run, are not promoted

P20.name: Deleting an ended run's logs answers each state's log as deleted, and a second deletion as done

P21.name: Deleting a run's logs needs SPACE_ADMIN on the account, which a space admin below it lacks

P22.name: A run that has not ended keeps its logs, and an unknown run's are not deleted

P23.name: A run the caller cannot read does not exist, and a reader neither cancels a blocking run nor sets a priority

P24.name: A stop ends a plan a hook holds, and the run becomes STOPPED

P25.name: A space reader stops and kills no run that holds its stack's lock

P26.name: A run whose state takes neither, a state the run has left and an unknown run are refused

P27.name: A kill ends a plan whose hook ignores the stop, and the run fails with the note "killed"

P28.name: Confirming the run that holds the lock assigns it to a worker to apply

P29.name: A space reader neither confirms nor discards the run

P30.name: A run that does not wait for confirmation, a run of another stack, an unknown run and a stack with no blocking run are refused

P31.name: A replanned run is claimed with its targets, plans again and waits for confirmation again

P32.name: A space reader and the run's in-run API token are refused, and a tier without targeted-replan refuses every replan

P33.name: A run that does not wait, no address, an address that is not one and an unknown run are refused, and a restore that fails fails the run

P34.name: Direct, list and search reads share the winning sources and computed run metadata

P35.name: A reader sees the same source view without secrets, changes none and sees no hidden stack

P36.name: A stack needs a name, a repository, a branch, a free slug and a space the account holds

P37.name: A search of a field stacks lack, a constraint its field does not take, or an altered cursor is refused

P38.name: On a stack, an If-Match of a version since changed answers 412

P39.name: On a stack, a PATCH keeps what it leaves out and a PUT resets it

P40.name: A switched-off option refuses the requests that set it

P41.name: A body over the bound answers 413 on every surface, and one at the bound is read

P42.name: A space reader reads the stacks of its spaces alone and changes none

P43.name: With vendor-terragrunt switched off, every request that sets the Terragrunt member answers 403 naming it

P44.name: Another account's stack answers 404, and each account's slugs are its own

P45.name: An account admin creates, reads, changes, moves, reslugs and deletes a stack

P46.name: Each caller's stars are its own, and an admin disables and enables a stack

P47.name: A grant committed with no message reaches the member's next request on either replica

P48.name: A lock is lifted by its holder or forced by an admin, and refuses every other lock

P49.name: A new stack tracks its branch's head, a sync follows a push, and a set pins an earlier commit

P50.name: A space reader is refused, and a stack the caller cannot read does not exist

P51.name: A commit the repository lacks is refused, and a host that does not answer is unavailable

L1.name: An in-run token cannot read the stack's full run or task projections
